notes: NVIDIA recording stutter fixed. The polling loop no longer creates a CreateRemoteThread in already-hooked nvcontainer.exe hosts every 30s (that remote thread was what caused mid-recording hitches - NVIDIA's capture thread had to context-switch to service it every cycle). Hooked PIDs are now cached, so the polling tick costs one process snapshot + hash-set lookup unless a new nvcontainer.exe actually spawns. FTS + cursor registry writes only happen once per Myst session, not on every activation. Idle poll interval bumped 30s -> 60s. Also writes 'include cursor' hints to every documented NVIDIA registry location (HKCU ShadowPlay\NVSPCAPS + HKLM NvContainer\ShadowPlay) so the setting sticks regardless of whether the customer has NVIDIA App or legacy GeForce Experience installed.
